description: Hi everyone! I'm a software developer skilled in full-stack development, AI, mobile apps, and DevOps, with experience in Python, Laravel, React, Next.js, and Flutter. For NASA Space Apps 2026, I'm focusing on Flame in Freefall, using AI and NASA data to improve space fire safety. I'm looking for passionate teammates skilled in AI/ML, data science, physics, UI/UX, or software development. Let's combine our talents, innovate, and build something impactful together!
